description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the I18NError entity class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing persistence, constraints, and exception handling related to the I18NError entity.

classes.name: I18NErrorTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the I18NError entity, testing CRUD operations, uniqueness constraints, null constraints, and exception handling within the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating the I18NError table before each test.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntity
methods.description: Tests creation, persistence, and retrieval of an I18NError entity with valid data.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithDuplicateName
methods.description: Verifies that creating an I18NError entity with a duplicate name triggers a UniqueConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithNullName
methods.description: Checks that missing the name (which is likely a required field) causes an EntityMissingAssignedId exception.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithNullDescription
methods.description: Tests that the absence of a message (description) triggers a NotNullConstraintViolationException.
